# agentsfleet — Fleet Delivery Control Plane

## Machine-readable API surfaces
- OpenAPI spec: /openapi.json
- agentsfleet manifest: /agentsfleet-manifest.json (JSON Linked Data)
- Health/status: /healthz
- Documentation: /docs

## API base
https://agentsfleet.net/v1

## Operations (operationId: method path)
A fleet is a chat from its first message. Archiving rides PATCH on the fleet resource — body {status: "archived"}.
A tripped gate archives the fleet.
- create_fleet:        POST   /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fleets     # body: {message, operation_id, model_ref?, name?} — an active fleet and its first turn
- patch_fleet:         PATCH  /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fleets/{fleet_id}     # body: {name?, status?, model_ref?, http_egress?, package_domains?}
                       #   status "archived" — cancel its work, keep history (irreversible)
                       #   http_egress / package_domains — a signed-in person only; an API key is refused 403
- list_fleet_triggers: GET    /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fleets/{fleet_id}/triggers   # what may wake the fleet
- remove_fleet_trigger: DELETE /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fleets/{fleet_id}/triggers/{trigger_id}
- delete_fleet:        DELETE /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fleets/{fleet_id}     # hard-purge in any status
- post_fleet_message:  POST   /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fleets/{fleet_id}/messages   # steer / chat
- list_fleet_turns:    GET    /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fleets/{fleet_id}/turns
- stream_fleet_turns:  GET    /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/fleets/{fleet_id}/turns/stream
- ingest_connector_webhook: POST /v1/ingress/{provider}
- ingest_qstash_schedule: POST /v1/ingress/qstash/schedules
- receive_source_webhook: POST /v1/webhooks/{fleet_id}/{source}   # the URL a webhook trigger lists
- get_tenant_billing:         GET /v1/tenants/me/billing
- get_tenant_billing_charges: GET /v1/tenants/me/billing/charges
- get_tenant_billing_report: GET /v1/tenants/me/billing/reports/current
- get_model_library:      GET /v1/models    # paged; ?limit=&starting_after=&q=&provider= — ETag/If-None-Match
- list_tenant_model_entries: GET /v1/tenants/me/models   # paged; the tenant's own model registry
- runner_web_search: POST /v1/runners/me/runs/{run_id}/searches   # held public fleet run; one fenced search with a tool call number
- runner_web_extract: POST /v1/runners/me/runs/{run_id}/extracts   # held public fleet run; one fenced HTTPS page read with a tool call number

Every list above is a bounded keyset page: read `next_cursor` and follow it.
A client that reads only the first page silently loses everything past it.

## Authentication
Bearer token: Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
The two runner web operations require the assigned runner's bearer token (RunnerBearerAuth). The platform supplies the web vendor credentials.
The QStash schedule ingress uses QStash delivery signatures instead of a bearer token.

## Execution model
A Fleet is a long-lived, event-driven autonomous worker scoped to a workspace.
Events reach it from its triggers (signed webhooks at
`POST /v1/webhooks/{fleet_id}/{source}`, including Svix-signed sources, schedules and chat mentions) and from
steer messages. Each accepted turn is committed to `thread.turns`.
The control plane (`agentsfleetd`) claims queued admissions and runs them to a
host-resident `agentsfleet-runner`. The runner runs the Fleet's loop, which can call tools, update state,
and emit further events. Operators steer or kill running Fleets through the
control-plane endpoints above.
